name: EMA Lightning (Turkish TTS, 8.6M)
vendor: canberkkkkkk (individual, with a Turkish text frontend by a third party)
purpose: Tiny, fast, accurate Turkish text-to-speech: 5.6M-parameter DiT acoustic model plus 3M vocoder, about 34 MB, runs on GPU or CPU offline (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag and config.json say apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo (404).

architecture.kind: flow-matching DiT acoustic model (4 sampling steps, 25 Hz latents) + vocoder, 48 kHz output; letter-level text encoder with duration predictor and windowed aligner

pc-12gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-16gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

benchmarks.name: Freya-TR-Eval WER
benchmarks.harness: card says lowest of every system measured incl. ElevenLabs v4, Gemini 3.8 and the 2.38B Trendyol-TTS; first audio 3.86 ms and 440x real time on RTX 4090 (vendor)

weaknesses: benchmark is the author's against a Turkish eval set
soft.maturity: 79k downloads, 468 likes in 7 weeks; sibling 'oruk/orukeet' unrelated.

tona_fit.reason: Turkish only. Listed as evidence that very small language-specific flow-matching TTS reaches commercial WER.

open_questions: Benchmark independence unknown; arXiv 2405.14867 tagged (not read)
